integrity.finite_check: Standard-library outward-rounded Poisson interval summation with explicit positive tail bound.
integrity.proof: Analytic convergence, discontinuous limit, and finite-witness extremum argument.
integrity.source_priority: First public appearance of the motivating 0.1% filter paper verified October 14, 2023.

limitations: Independent Poisson read counts, constant expected composition and one spurious category; no PCR, batch, or index-hopping dependence.
Strict local-maximum lower bounds, not an exact census of all extrema.
The arbitrary-peak theorem varies the relative-abundance cutoff while keeping the spurious-to-cutoff intensity ratio fixed.
No empirical validation and no recommendation to tune real sequencing depth to these peaks.
title: Arbitrarily many spurious depth peaks under relative-read filtering
